你.tip: 亻 (person) + 尔. The other person you talk to is you.

好.tip: 女 (woman) + 子 (child). A mother with her child is good.

您.tip: 你 on top of 心 (heart). You, with respect from my heart.

们.tip: 亻 (person) + 门 (mén, door). Many people at the door, so 们 makes words plural.

老.tip: Picture an old man bending over his walking stick. 老 = old.

师.tip: The left part is the teacher's pointer stick, the right part is the board.

谢.tip: 讠 (speech) + 身 (body) + 寸 (hand). Bow your body and say thank you.

不.tip: 一 is the sky. A little bird flies up but can not pass it.

客.tip: 宀 (roof) + 各 (each). Each person under your roof is a guest.

气.tip: Lines of steam rising up into the air.

对.tip: 又 (hand) + 寸 (hand). Two hands facing each other.

起.tip: 走 (walk) + 己 (self). Get yourself up and walking.

没.tip: 氵 (water) on the left. Something sank in the water, now it's gone.

关.tip: Two little horns on top of 天. Think of a gate with a bolt across it.

系.tip: Silk thread 糸 hanging down. Threads tie things together.

再.tip: Layers stacked one on top of another, again and again.

见.tip: An eye walking on two legs: it goes out to see.

请.tip: 讠 (speech) + 青 (qīng, sounds like qǐng). Speak nicely: please.

进.tip: 辶 (walking road) + 井 (jǐng, sounds like jìn). Walk in.

坐.tip: Two people 人 人 sitting on the ground 土.

听.tip: 口 (mouth) on the left. Someone speaks, you listen.

说.tip: 讠 (speech) + 兑, a person with an open mouth talking.

读.tip: 讠 (speech) + 卖 (mài, sell). Read out loud, like a seller calling out.

写.tip: 冖 is the desk cover, 与 is your hand holding the pen.

叫.tip: 口 (mouth) + 丩 (two vines twisting). Open your mouth and call out a name.

什.tip: 亻 (person) + 十 (ten). A person facing ten things asks: what?

么.tip: 丿 + 厶 (a little hook). A tiny tail that turns 什 into 什么 “what”.

名.tip: 夕 (evening) + 口 (mouth). In the dark evening you call out your name so people know you.

字.tip: 宀 (roof) + 子 (child). A child learning under the roof: learning characters.

我.tip: 手 (hand) + 戈 (spear). A hand holding a spear says: this is me.

是.tip: 日 (sun) + 正-like base (correct). As clear as the sun: it is so.

吗.tip: 口 (mouth) + 马 (mǎ, horse, gives the sound). A mouth asks “ma?” at the end of a question.

学.tip: ⺍ (light) + 冖 (cover) + 子 (child). A child under a roof, light coming in: studying.

生.tip: A sprout 屮 coming up from the ground 土: to grow, to be born.

她.tip: 女 (woman) + 也. The woman over there: she.

谁.tip: 讠 (speech) + 隹 (bird). Someone tweets like a bird: who is speaking?

的.tip: 白 (white) + 勺 (spoon). My white spoon: the 's that shows whose it is.

汉.tip: 氵 (water) + 又. The Han river gave its name to the Chinese people.

语.tip: 讠 (speech) + 吾 (wú, I). What I speak: language.

国.tip: 囗 (border) + 玉 (jade). A treasure inside the borders: a country.

呢.tip: 口 (mouth) + 尼 (ní, gives the sound). A mouth asking back: “and you?”

同.tip: 冂 (frame) + 一 + 口. Mouths in one frame say the same thing.

朋.tip: Two 月 side by side, like two friends walking together.

家.tip: 宀 (roof) + 豕 (pig). A pig under a roof: in old China, a farm home.

有.tip: 𠂇 (hand) + 月 (meat). A hand holding meat: to have.

口.tip: An open mouth, drawn as a square.

女.tip: A woman kneeling with crossed arms: woman.

几.tip: A small table: only room for a few things.

岁.tip: 山 (mountain) + 夕 (evening). Each evening over the mountain adds to your age.

了.tip: A child with arms tied: the action is finished.

今.tip: 人 (roof shape) + 一 + ㇇. Under this roof, right now.

年.tip: A person carrying grain: one harvest a year.

大.tip: A person with arms stretched wide: big.

四.tip: 囗 (box) with 儿 inside: a window with four sides.

五.tip: Two lines with a crossing in between: the middle of 1–10, five.

六.tip: A little house with a roof: six.

七.tip: A cross with a curled tail: seven.

八.tip: Two strokes parting: eight (sounds like 发, getting rich).

九.tip: An arm with a hook: nine, the biggest single digit.

会.tip: 人 (people) + 云 (cloud). People gathering like clouds: a meeting; you can do it.

妈.tip: 女 (woman) + 马 (mǎ, horse, gives the sound). The woman you call “mā”: mom.

菜.tip: 艹 (grass) + 采 (to pick). Green plants you pick: vegetables, a dish.

很.tip: 彳 (step) + 艮 (stubborn). Stubborn steps: very determined.

吃.tip: 口 (mouth) + 乞 (to beg). A mouth begging for food: to eat.

做.tip: 亻 (person) + 故 (reason). A person with a reason gets things done.

怎.tip: 乍 (suddenly) + 心 (heart). The heart suddenly wonders: how?

问.tip: 门 (door) + 口 (mouth). A mouth at the door: to ask.

天.tip: 一 above 大 (a big person): what is above us, the sky; a day.

号.tip: 口 (mouth) + 丂. A mouth calling out numbers.

星.tip: 日 (sun) + 生 (born). Little suns being born: stars. 星期 = week.

期.tip: 其 + 月 (moon). Counting moons: a period of time.

昨.tip: 日 (day) + 乍 (suddenly). A day that suddenly passed: yesterday.

明.tip: 日 (sun) + 月 (moon): the brightest things. 明天 = tomorrow.

去.tip: 土 (ground) + 厶. Leaving the ground behind: to go.

校.tip: 木 (wood) + 交 (to cross; meet). Where people meet under wooden roofs: school.

看.tip: 手 (hand) over 目 (eye). A hand shading the eye to look far.

书.tip: A brush writing on a page: book.

想.tip: 相 + 心 (heart). Something on your heart: to think of, to want.

喝.tip: 口 (mouth) + 曷 (hé, gives the sound). The mouth goes “hē”: to drink.

茶.tip: 艹 (plant) + 人 + 木 (tree). A person between plant and tree: picking tea.

饭.tip: 饣 (food) + 反 (fǎn, gives the sound). Food: a meal.

午.tip: A pestle standing straight up, like the sun at noon.

商.tip: A stand with goods and a mouth 口 calling buyers: trade.

店.tip: 广 (roof open on one side) + 占 (to take a spot). A spot under a roof: a shop.

买.tip: A net (乛) over goods (头): to buy and take home.

个.tip: 人 (person) + 丨. One stick under a roof: one item.

子.tip: A baby wrapped up with arms out: child. Also a noun ending (杯子, 椅子).

这.tip: 辶 (walking) + 文. Walking up to it: this one here.

少.tip: 小 (small) + 丿 (cut). Small and cut down: few.

钱.tip: 钅 (metal) + 戋 (small pieces). Small pieces of metal: money.

块.tip: 土 (earth) + 夬. A lump of earth: a piece; one yuan.

那.tip: 冄 + 阝 (town). The town over there: that.

小.tip: A line with two small dots: small.

猫.tip: 犭 (animal) + 苗 (miáo, sounds like a cat's “miao”).

在.tip: 土 (ground) under a hand: right here, at this place.

狗.tip: 犭 (animal) + 句 (gǒu sound). The animal that barks: dog.

面.tip: A face 目 inside its frame: face, side.

作.tip: 亻 (person) + 乍. A person busy doing: to work.

医.tip: 匚 (box) + 矢 (arrow). Arrows removed and put in a box: healing.

院.tip: 阝 (hill) + 完 (complete). A complete set of buildings: an institution (医院 hospital).

爸.tip: 父 (father) + 巴 (bā, gives the sound): dad.

桌.tip: 卓 (tall) + 木 (wood). A tall wooden thing: table.

电.tip: A lightning bolt through a field: electricity.

脑.tip: 月 (body) + 㐫 (head). The part of your body in your head: brain. 电脑 = computer.

和.tip: 禾 (grain) + 口 (mouth). Grain for every mouth: peace and harmony, and.

本.tip: 木 (tree) + a mark at the bottom: the root.

里.tip: 田 (field) + 土 (earth). Inside the village fields: in.

能.tip: A bear (能 is an old picture of a bear): strong, able.

现.tip: 王 (jade) + 见 (see). Jade you can see: it appears, now.

点.tip: 占 + 灬 (fire). Sparks from a fire: dots.

分.tip: 八 (split) + 刀 (knife). A knife splits things: to divide; a minute.

中.tip: A line through the middle of a box.

时.tip: 日 (sun) + 寸 (measure). Measuring the sun: time.

候.tip: 亻 (person) + 侯. A person waiting for the right time.

回.tip: A box in a box: going round and back.

影.tip: 景 (scene) + 彡 (rays). Rays and a scene: a shadow, a film.

住.tip: 亻 (person) + 主 (master). The person who is master of a place lives there.

样.tip: 木 (wood) + 羊. Carved wood in the shape of a sheep. 怎么样 = how is it.

太.tip: 大 (big) + a dot: even bigger, too big.

热.tip: 执 (to hold) + 灬 (fire). Holding something over a fire: hot.

姐.tip: 女 (woman) + 且. 小姐 = Miss.

来.tip: A wheat plant, a gift that comes from heaven.

身.tip: A person with a big belly: the body.

体.tip: 亻 (person) + 本 (root). The root of a person: the body.

爱.tip: 爫 (hand) + 冖 (cover) + 友 (friend). Holding a friend close: love.

些.tip: 此 (this) + 二 (two). This and a couple more: some.

水.tip: A stream with splashes on both sides: water.

果.tip: 田 on top of 木 (tree): fruit hanging on a tree.

喂.tip: 口 (mouth) + 畏. The mouth says “wèi?” when you pick up the phone.

习.tip: A wing with feathers: a bird practising flying.

睡.tip: 目 (eye) + 垂 (to droop). Eyelids drooping: to sleep.

觉.tip: ⺍ + 冖 + 见 (see). Seeing nothing under the cover: sleep.

视.tip: 礻 + 见 (see). To look at. 电视 = TV.

喜.tip: A drum 壴 and a mouth 口 singing: happy.

欢.tip: 又 + 欠 (open mouth). An open mouth laughing: joy. 喜欢 = to like.

给.tip: 纟 (silk) + 合 (to join). Joining silk threads into a gift: to give.

打.tip: 扌 (hand) + 丁 (nail). A hand hitting a nail: to hit.

话.tip: 讠 (speech) + 舌 (tongue). Tongue and speech: words.

吧.tip: 口 (mouth) + 巴 (bā, gives the sound). A soft “ba” to make a suggestion.

东.tip: The sun rising behind a tree: east. 东西 = thing.

西.tip: A bird settling in its nest when the sun sets: west.

苹.tip: 艹 (plant) + 平 (píng, gives the sound).

先.tip: A foot 止 ahead of a person 儿: going first.

开.tip: Two hands lifting the bar of a gate: to open.

车.tip: A cart seen from above, with its axle: vehicle.

钟.tip: 钅 (metal) + 中 (middle). A metal bell: a clock.

漂.tip: 氵 (water) + 票. Something floating on water. 漂亮 = pretty.

亮.tip: A tall building with lights on top: bright.

啊.tip: 口 (mouth) + 阿 (ā, gives the sound): “ah!”

都.tip: 者 + 阝 (city). All the people of a city: all.

认.tip: 讠 (speech) + 人 (person). Speaking to a person you recognise.

识.tip: 讠 (speech) + 只. 认识 = to know someone.

出.tip: Two mountains 山 stacked: climbing up and out.

租.tip: 禾 (grain) + 且. Paying grain as rent. 出租车 = taxi.

高.tip: A tall tower with a roof: tall.

兴.tip: Hands raised up high: excitement. 高兴 = happy.

机.tip: 木 (wood) + 几 (small table). A wooden device: a machine. 飞机 = plane.

旅.tip: 方 (direction) + a group of people walking under a flag: travelling.

游.tip: 氵 (water) + 方 + 子 (child). A child moving through water: to swim, to tour.

得.tip: 彳 (step) + 㝵 (to obtain). Taking steps to get something.

最.tip: 曰 + 取 (to take). Taking the top: the most.

为.tip: A hand doing work for someone. 为什么 = why.

运.tip: 辶 (walking) + 云 (cloud). Moving like clouds: motion. 运动 = sport.

动.tip: 云 + 力 (strength). Using strength to move.

足.tip: 口 (knee) above a foot: the foot. 足球 = football.

球.tip: 王 (jade) + 求 (qiú, gives the sound). A round jade ball.

要.tip: 覀 + 女 (woman). A woman who wants something.

新.tip: 亲 + 斤 (axe). Freshly cut wood: new.

它.tip: 宀 (roof) + 匕. A snake under the roof: it.

睛.tip: 目 (eye) + 青 (qīng, clear). Clear eyes. 眼睛 = eye.

病.tip: 疒 (sickbed) + 丙. Lying on a sickbed: ill.

每.tip: A mother 母 with a hat: every mother.

早.tip: 日 (sun) over 十: the sun just above the horizon: early.

跑.tip: 足 (foot) + 包 (bāo). Feet moving fast: to run.

步.tip: 止 (foot) above another foot: a step. 跑步 = jog.

床.tip: 广 (shelter) + 木 (wood). A wooden thing under a roof: bed.

知.tip: 矢 (arrow) + 口 (mouth). Words straight as an arrow: you know.

道.tip: 辶 (walk) + 首 (head). Where your head leads you: the way. 知道 = to know.

休.tip: 亻 (person) leaning on 木 (tree): to rest.

忙.tip: 忄 (heart) + 亡 (lost). Your heart lost in work: busy.

间.tip: 门 (door) + 日 (sun). Sunlight through a gap in the door: between. 时间 = time.

表.tip: A coat 衣 with fur on the outside: what shows. 手表 = watch.

千.tip: 丿 + 十: one stroke on ten: a thousand.

报.tip: 扌 (hand) + 㞋. 报纸 = newspaper.

纸.tip: 纟 (silk) + 氏. Made from fibres: paper.

送.tip: 辶 (walking) + 关. Walking someone off: to send, to give.

牛.tip: A cow's head with horns: cow. 牛奶 = milk.

房.tip: 户 (door) + 方 (fāng, gives the sound). A door: a room.

丈.tip: A hand holding a measuring stick. 丈夫 = husband.

夫.tip: 大 (person) with a hairpin: a grown man.

旁.tip: A roof and 方: at the side. 旁边 = beside.

边.tip: 辶 (walking) + 力. Walking along the edge.

真.tip: 十 + 目 (eye) + 八: seen with your own eyes: true.

粉.tip: 米 (rice) + 分 (to divide). Rice divided fine: powder. 粉色 = pink.

色.tip: A person kneeling under another: face colour.

颜.tip: 彦 + 页 (head). The face. 颜色 = colour.

左.tip: 𠂇 (hand) + 工 (tool). The hand that holds the tool: left.

日.tip: The sun, a circle with a dot.

快.tip: 忄 (heart) + 夬. A light heart: happy; quick.

乐.tip: A drum on a stand: music, joy. 快乐 = happy.

接.tip: 扌 (hand) + 妾. Hands reaching out to receive.

晚.tip: 日 (sun) + 免 (to escape). The sun has gone: evening.

非.tip: Two wings facing away: not, wrong. 非常 = very.

常.tip: 尚 + 巾 (cloth). Cloth used every day: often.

始.tip: 女 (woman) + 台. Life begins with a woman: to begin.

经.tip: 纟 (silk) + 𢀖. Threads passing through a loom. 已经 = already.

帮.tip: 邦 + 巾 (cloth). Giving cloth to a neighbour: to help.

介.tip: 人 + 丨丨: a person between two things. 介绍 = introduce.

绍.tip: 纟 (thread) + 召 (to summon). 介绍 = introduce.

外.tip: 夕 (evening) + 卜 (fortune). Fortune-telling at night, outside the usual.

准.tip: 冫 + 隹 (bird). Aiming at a bird: accurate. 准备 = prepare.

备.tip: 夂 + 田 (field). Preparing the field.

就.tip: 京 (capital) + 尤. Going to the capital then.

鱼.tip: A fish with head, scales and tail.

件.tip: 亻 + 牛 (cow). Counting things one by one.

还.tip: 辶 (walking) + 不. Not leaving yet: still.

可.tip: 丁 + 口 (mouth). The mouth says: you can.

以.tip: A person holding a tool. 可以 = can, may.

考.tip: An old man 耂 with a cane: examining. 考试 = exam.

试.tip: 讠 (speech) + 式 (style). Trying out words: test.

意.tip: 音 (sound) + 心 (heart). The sound of the heart: meaning.

自.tip: A nose: you point to your nose to mean self.

行.tip: A crossroads: to walk. 自行车 = bicycle.

条.tip: 夂 + 木 (tree). A long branch: a strip. 面条 = noodles.

因.tip: 大 (person) inside 囗: there's a reason.

所.tip: 户 (door) + 斤 (axe). 所以 = so.

泳.tip: 氵 (water) + 永 (long). Long in the water: to swim.

公.tip: 八 (divide) + 厶 (private). Splitting the private: public.

斤.tip: An axe: a unit of weight. 公斤 = kilogram.

室.tip: 宀 (roof) + 至 (to arrive). Where you arrive: a room.

场.tip: 土 (earth) + 昜 (sun). An open sunny field. 机场 = airport.

路.tip: 足 (foot) + 各 (each). Where every foot goes: road.

司.tip: A hand over a mouth giving orders. 公司 = company.

远.tip: 辶 (walking) + 元. A long walk: far.

共.tip: Two hands holding something up together. 公共汽车 = bus.

汽.tip: 氵 (water) + 气 (air). Water as air: steam. 汽车 = car.

慢.tip: 忄 (heart) + 曼 (long). A long, patient heart: slow.

走.tip: 土 + 止 (foot): a foot on the ground: to walk.

让.tip: 讠 (speech) + 上. Speaking to allow: to let.

告.tip: 牛 (cow) + 口 (mouth). Announcing with the mouth: to tell.

诉.tip: 讠 (speech) + 斥. 告诉 = to tell.

等.tip: ⺮ (bamboo) + 寺. Bamboo slips in order: to wait your turn.

找.tip: 扌 (hand) + 戈 (spear). A hand searching with a spear.

事.tip: A hand holding a brush: doing a task.

情.tip: 忄 (heart) + 青 (qīng). Feelings of the heart. 事情 = matter.

务.tip: 夂 + 力 (strength). Work needing strength: task. 服务员 = waiter.

员.tip: 口 + 贝 (money). A person paid: a member, staff.

黑.tip: A chimney over fire 灬: soot, black.

贵.tip: 中 + 一 + 贝 (money). Lots of money: expensive.

从.tip: Two people, one following another: from, follow.

跳.tip: 足 (foot) + 兆. The feet jump. 跳舞 = dance.

舞.tip: A dancer holding ribbons, feet below: dance.

希.tip: 㐅 + 布 (cloth). Rare cloth you hope for. 希望 = hope.

望.tip: 亡 + 月 (moon) + 王. Looking at the moon: to hope.

题.tip: 是 + 页 (head). What's at the head: a question.

迎.tip: 辶 (walking) + 卬. Walking out to welcome.

班.tip: Jade split by a knife 刂 into two: a group, class.

懂.tip: 忄 (heart) + 董 (dǒng). Understanding in the heart.

完.tip: 宀 (roof) + 元. A house complete: finished.

课.tip: 讠 (speech) + 果 (fruit). Words that bear fruit: a lesson.

助.tip: 且 + 力 (strength). Lending strength: to help.

别.tip: 另 + 刂 (knife). Cutting apart: other; don't.

哥.tip: 可 on 可: someone who can, twice over: big brother.

鸡.tip: 又 + 鸟 (bird). The everyday bird: chicken.

蛋.tip: 疋 + 虫. What a hen lays: egg.

瓜.tip: A melon hanging on a vine. 西瓜 = watermelon.

正.tip: 一 above 止 (foot): standing straight. 正在 = in the middle of.

洗.tip: 氵 (water) + 先. Water first: to wash.

唱.tip: 口 (mouth) + 昌 (bright). A bright voice: to sing.

歌.tip: 哥 (gē) + 欠 (open mouth). Open your mouth: song.

男.tip: 田 (field) + 力 (strength). Strength in the field: man.

右.tip: 𠂇 (hand) + 口 (mouth). The hand you eat with: right.

便.tip: 亻 + 更 (change). 便宜 = cheap.

宜.tip: 宀 (roof) + 且. Under one roof, all fits. 便宜 = cheap.

姓.tip: 女 (woman) + 生 (born). Your mother's line: surname.

妻.tip: A hand doing up a woman's hair: wife. 妻子 = wife.

雪.tip: 雨 (rain) + 彐 (hand). Rain you can hold: snow.

零.tip: 雨 (rain) + 令. A raindrop: zero, tiny.

度.tip: 广 + 廿 + 又 (hand). A hand measuring: degree.

穿.tip: 穴 (cave) + 牙 (tooth). A tooth piercing a hole: to put through, wear.

弟.tip: A spear wrapped in rope, in order: little brother.

近.tip: 辶 (walking) + 斤. A short walk: near.

着.tip: 羊 + 目 (eye). Eyes fixed on: keeps on.

拿.tip: 合 (to close) + 手 (hand). A closed hand: to hold.

铅.tip: 钅 (metal) + 㕣. 铅笔 = pencil.

笑.tip: ⺮ (bamboo) + 夭. Bamboo bending in the wind like a laughing person.

宾.tip: 宀 (roof) + 兵. A visitor under your roof: guest. 宾馆 = hotel.

馆.tip: 饣 (food) + 官. A building where food is served: hall.

但.tip: 亻 + 旦 (dawn). 但是 = but.

虽.tip: 口 + 虫 (insect). 虽然 = although.

然.tip: 肰 (dog meat) + 灬 (fire). 虽然 = although.

次.tip: 冫 + 欠 (yawn). Yawning again and again: times.

玩.tip: 王 (jade) + 元. Playing with jade: play.

晴.tip: 日 (sun) + 青 (clear). A clear sun: sunny.

票.tip: 覀 + 示 (to show). Something you show: a ticket.

站.tip: 立 (stand) + 占. A place to stand: station.

妹.tip: 女 (woman) + 未 (not yet). The one not yet grown: little sister.

阴.tip: 阝 (hill) + 月 (moon). The shady side of the hill: cloudy.
